sanskrit_verse:
द्रव्यप्रमाणहीनं यत् फलोपाश्रयवर्जितम् ।
प्रमाणवर्जितं नाम लेख्यदोषं तद् उत्सृजेत् ॥
transliteration: dravyapramāṇahīnaṃ yat phalopāśrayavarjitam | pramāṇavarjitaṃ nāma lekhyadoṣaṃ tad utsṛjet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which lacks proper measurement of substance and is devoid of purpose or result is to be rejected as a written defect named 'pramāṇavarjita.'
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with pramāṇa (valid means of knowledge)
Causation requires both instrumental and resultant integrity
Capacity-based responsibility demands recognition of valid action-supporting elements
Restoration logic operates through rejection of invalid foundations
Consciousness alignment necessitates clarity in documentation and intent
executable_legal_axioms: IF a document lacks measurable substance AND has no actionable outcome THEN it SHALL be classified as 'pramāṇavarjita'
IF a record is marked 'pramāṇavarjita' THEN all derivative actions based thereon SHALL be suspended pending revalidation
IF validation criteria for substance and purpose are met THEN the document MAY be reinstated by authorized consciousness-aligned adjudicator
ALL legal instruments MUST include pramāṇa-supported definitions of substance and intended result
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any pleading or evidence found lacking in definable substance or clear causal linkage shall be deemed 'pramāṇavarjita' and excluded from consideration until rectified. This ensures that only consciousness-aligned, pramāṇa-rooted material informs judicial discernment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands that documents reflect accurate perception, inference, or testimony regarding substance and function. Where these are absent, the defect lies not in intent but in foundational validity. Therefore, correction—not condemnation—is mandated under Nyaya, preserving dharma through conscious realignment rather than punitive exclusion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process requiring submitter to provide measurable content and stated objective
Assign responsibility assumption protocol wherein author affirms alignment with pramāṇa
Deploy capacity restoration mechanism allowing revision under guidance of qualified instructor
Execute integrity reintegration upon successful validation, restoring document status within legal flow
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: defects rooted in absence of pramāṇa call for conscious restoration alone; Dharma prevails through clarity, not punishment; reality itself adjudicates through awakened awareness.
